reviews.text: Nala and I absolutely loved the scent taster  workshop! It went at a pace suitable for both dog and owner. I was able to make notes and get the full benefit from the course! After a few hours snoozing she was able to find a scent on the side of the washing machine impressing the family! I think it will really mentally stimulate her and I feel fairly confident to do this with her thanks to both Mandy and Sam. Thankyou so much! We look forward to the next course.

Fantastic workshop with Mandy and Jemma. They’re so knowledgeable, patient and professional. Made accommodations for the dogs in the workshop where needed, the exercises were all fun and my dog loved it! Will definitely be booking in more!

Absolutely super sessions for Dog and Handlers. built a bond with my dog I hadnt known i could, made my busy active dog more focused and calmer but still keeping that  super motivated fun exuberant peroanlity  i love. Cant rate Mandy and Scentwork highly  enough.

Mandy and the team are excellent!. Can't praise the course enough.
Dogs really enjoyed it, informative and no rush. Want to continue without a doubt u like other course ive attended elsewhere.
Thank you!

Took part in a Scent Work for Beginners workshop with my overexcited springer/collie. Was a brilliant experience and both humans and puppy learned so much.

Looking forward to the next one!!! Will be purchasing the 'Nose Magic' to keep us busy until then.

Thank you!
Fabulous workshop with a great mix of practice alongside the reasoning behind it.

I highly recommend Mandy and The Scentwork Academy! We attended the beginners workshop, and my dachshund had a fantastic afternoon. We learned so much and came away with plenty of tips and techniques to practice. Everyone was so welcoming, and the session was both fun and informative.

We have adored the online content (and any training) Mandy provides! Her knowledge and joy is evident.
Our little sausage went to Mandy's classes but when we moved it was just too far.
To be able to continue the scentwork journey is much appreciated.
You can do the modules at your own pace.
It’s a wealth of ideas to engage your dog, wonderful in this heat.
We have found it builds such a great bond, and she is exhausted after too!

This was a really well thought out and presented workshop.  My dog and I thoroughly enjoyed learning new skills with practical tasks and helpful information.  We are looking forward to attending more sessions in the future. Thank you.

The scent training workshops were expertly lead by Mandy with just the right balance of instruction and practical. Developing handler and dog training at each level. Thoroughly enjoyable and recommended to any dog with a nose!

Had a great time with my flatcoated retriever Rwbi doing the introduction to scent work workshop recently.
Mandy and Jemma were lovely and provided a most welcoming and supportive environment for us to learn and have fun.
I am really looking forward to doing more and i know Rwbi is!

Completed the ‘sniff it out’ experience with Mandy and Gemma.
Both were super approachable, experienced, and engaging.
Definitely recommend to those looking for a new bonding exercise/ experience with your dog.

Had a 1-2-1 scentwork assessment with my dog Linkon which we both thoroughly enjoyed. Relaxed environment and Mandy really listened to Link's story and built his assessment around his strenghts and weaknesses. Highly recommended.

We had a great 121 with Mandy this week, clear instruction and guidance along with easy to follow guides for homework, so we can practice.  Lots of fun and brain engaging activities, loved our session. …

Thank you for you great review 👍
Kind Regards 
Scent Work Academy  …
Excellent afternoon, interesting and instructive Samantha and I enjoyed it. Would definitely recommend, very professional. Thank you.

Mandy ran a Sniff It Out Level 1 session.  It was very informative, Mandy adapted the session with ease when she realised my dog was already imprinted on cloves.  We covered lots, enjoyed our session and have booked again.
A brilliant workshop, very friendly and welcoming, packed with lots of information and fun sessions for you and your dog to experience. I would highly recommend

An excellent and informative workshop for learning about scentwork. The basics were very well explained, the dogs all had many opportunities for practice, and the evaluation for each handler was clear and positive. Thoroughly enjoyed the day - as did my dog! 🐾 …

Completed the Scent Work Academy with my 6 month old spaniel. Small classes, good mix of information and practical work. Trainers were quick to respond and adapt to all the dogs needs keeping the atmosphere relaxed and fun. Really enjoyed ourselves and would definitely recommend.
